title: Shesha blueprint IR (machine twin)
description: The JSON twin of a screen blueprint. Comprehension emits it alongside the Markdown blueprint (fenced ```blueprint-json block); form-edit's compile-blueprint.js accepts ONLY this as build input — no spec, no build (L2).

theme.description: theme token file name (e.g. 'shesha'); styling pass resolves it

property.description: camelCase entity property or dotted nav path [R-004, R-034]

component.description: explicit component type; omitted = by-datatype selection

assertions.description: placement contract verified after build (stable properties, never pixels)

node.description: A layout node — think of it as a React element. Compose the screen the way you would a React page: Stack/Row/Grid/Card for structure, Field/Text/Heading for content, Actions for buttons. The compiler maps each to the measured Shesha channel, so your flex/spacing/hierarchy instincts translate 1:1. See references/designing-like-react.md.

kind.description: layout | region: page root · stack: vertical flex · row: horizontal flex · grid: equal-width columns · card: surfaced panel · section: titled group · tabs/tab · field · text · heading · datatable · datalist · actions (Submit+exit buttonGroup) · chip. (container = alias of stack.)

title.description: card/section/tab heading, or a field's label override

width.description: flex-child width — %, px, fr or calc(); compiled to desktop.dimensions.width (the ONLY split lever [R-028])

gap.description: space between children — px number or scale token xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl; compiled to container gap

padding.description: inner padding — px number, scale token, or CSS shorthand; compiled to stylingBox

columns.description: kind=grid: column count (number); kind=datatable: bound column properties (string[])

property.description: kind=field: the bound entity property (camelCase / dotted path)

component.description: kind=field: explicit component type override (else by-datatype)
